# DivvyUp

> A no-login, shareable cost-splitting web app for groups.

DivvyUp lets any group track shared expenses — trips, meals, events, household costs — without creating an account. The owner gets three shareable links (owner / editor / view-only). The app calculates who owes what using a minimum-transactions settlement algorithm and lets participants mark payments as they happen.

## Technology

Built with SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 (runes), better-sqlite3, and Tailwind CSS v4. Self-hosted on Oracle Cloud behind Nginx. No third-party analytics or tracking.

## Key features

- No accounts — access via secret token links
- Even-split mode (checkbox per person) and custom-amount mode (dollar input per person)
- Tax percentage per expense item, with per-cell "tax already included" override
- Payment tracking with paid/unpaid toggle per cell
- Minimum-transactions settlement (greedy debt-simplification algorithm)
- Transposable grid (people ↔ expenses as rows/columns)
- Fork (copy) a divvy to create an independent editable duplicate
